Validation_Description: Verify dataset is non-empty and contains records
Zero duplicate business primary keys (Order_ID uniqueness)
All order dates must be valid ISO datetime objects
Order date must not occur in the future
Zero missing Customer_ID identifiers in processed records
Discount rate must be bounded between 0.0% and 100.0%
Gross_Sales must equal |Quantity| * Unit_Price within $0.05 tolerance
Net_Sales must equal Gross_Sales - Discount_Amount (signed for returns)
Category must belong to approved master taxonomy: ['Clothing', 'Furniture', 'Home & Kitchen', 'Office Supplies', 'Technology']
Order_Status must belong to approved lifecycle states: ['Cancelled', 'Delivered', 'Processing', 'Refunded', 'Shipped']
Profit_Margin_Percentage must not contain infinite values (zero denominator protection)
Extreme prices must be bounded after Winsorizing outlier treatment
